description: This file defines the 'Axis' class, a component representing a chart axis within the PDFsharp.Charting namespace. It includes properties for axis scaling, tick marks, labels, gridlines, and cloning functionality.

classes.name: Axis
classes.description: Represents an axis in a chart, including properties for scale, tick marks, labels, gridlines, and cloning functionality.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Axis object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs the deep copy operation of the Axis, cloning nested objects such as title, tick labels, line format, and gridlines.
